# MPLOYEDIN
> AI-Powered International Recruitment Platform

MPLOYEDIN is a dual-sided recruitment marketplace connecting employers worldwide
with top talent using AI-powered candidate matching and data-driven hiring tools.
The platform supports Arabic (RTL) and English, serving the GCC region (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman) and beyond.

## What MPLOYEDIN Does

- Connects employers with qualified candidates globally using AI-powered matching
- Enables job seekers to discover and apply to international opportunities
- Provides data-driven hiring insights and recruitment analytics
- Supports Arabic and English with full RTL interface

## AI Data Access (for AI assistants)

Read-only, key-protected platform data API for ChatGPT, Claude, n8n and other tools. Requires an admin-issued key (Authorization: Bearer mpi_…) or an admin MCP connection.
- https://mployedin-8a4rc.ondigitalocean.app/api/insights/openapi.json: OpenAPI 3.1 spec (import into GPT Actions)
- https://mployedin-8a4rc.ondigitalocean.app/api/insights/schema: Entities, fields and parameters (key required; read first)
- https://mployedin-8a4rc.ondigitalocean.app/api/mcp: MCP server (OAuth, admin scope read:insights)
- Docs: docs/AI-DATA-ACCESS.md in the repository
